name: ocean-cement-tanks-website
description: Bilingual (EN/AR) animated WordPress website for Ocean Cement Tanks IND L.L.C.SP
author: Eng Allaith.W67

scripts.build:js: mkdir -p dist && cat theme/js/oc.js theme/js/oc-extra.js > dist/bundle.js && terser dist/bundle.js -c -m -o dist/bundle.min.js
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist && cat theme/css/oc.css theme/css/oc-extra.css theme/css/oc-v3.css theme/css/oc-v4.css theme/css/oc-v5.css theme/css/oc-v6.css theme/css/oc-v7.css > dist/site.css
scripts.build:plugin: mkdir -p dist && cd plugin && zip -qr ../dist/ocean-core.zip ocean-core
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:plugin
